criteria.requirement: An actual 3D imaginary mountain island has recognizable peaks, valleys and a coastline.
criteria.action: Inspect the island from available exploration views.
criteria.expected: The real-time 3D island includes recognizable peaks, valleys and coastline.

criteria.requirement: The topographic-map treatment clearly communicates terrain height and structure.
criteria.action: Inspect terrain-height cues and topographic styling.
criteria.expected: The crafted topographic-map treatment communicates height and structure.

criteria.requirement: The terrain can be explored interactively through usable camera or map controls.
criteria.action: Explore using the offered camera or map controls and return to a useful view.
criteria.expected: Interaction visibly changes exploration state and remains usable.

criteria.requirement: Exploration keeps the island and important map information legible instead of losing the scene or obscuring it with labels.
criteria.action: Explore different areas at desktop and narrow-phone sizes.
criteria.expected: The island and relevant map information remain legible without obstructive labels or losing the scene.

scenarios.instruction: Inspect the whole island, peaks, valleys and coastal outline.
Explore different areas and viewpoints using the supplied controls.
Return to a useful overview and inspect narrow layout; do not invent required map layers or controls.

Inspect a 390px-wide viewport, including lower controls and focus navigation. Perform the task through the primary UI without relying on precise 3D camera manipulation. Record any clipped, obstructed or unreachable content.
